message:
You know, we all have that one friend who seems to be gloriously over-prepared for everything. The other day, I was at a picnic when they pulled out a full-on go-bag, complete with water, snacks, and even a mini first aid kit. At first, I chuckled, thinking they were being a bit extra. 

But as the day went on and a sudden rain shower hit, I found myself wishing I had a fraction of their foresight! It was a lovely reminder that being prepared doesn't mean we have to be extreme; sometimes, it's just about having a few essentials on hand. 

How do we find that balance between ready and relaxed? 🌦️
